common.disclaimer: LifeLens AI is an information and productivity tool. It does not give medical, legal, or financial advice. Always check important details against the original document.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.timeout: This is taking too long. Please try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The page you are looking for does not exist.

home.heroText: Turn everyday documents and notices into clear actions, deadlines, and reminders.
home.freeNote: Create a free account to save your tasks and reminders.
home.demoLabel: Example: a college notice turned into a task
home.notice1: Students must [[submit the completed project report]] by [[15 October 2026]].
home.notice2: The report must include [[the signed approval form]].
home.notice3: Students who fail to submit before the deadline may not be considered for evaluation.

capture.title: Capture
capture.text: Upload a PDF or photo, use your camera, or paste the text.

understand.title: Understand
understand.text: AI reads the document and pulls out dates, requirements, and a short summary.

act.title: Act
act.text: Every action becomes a task with a deadline and a priority you can change.

track.title: Track
track.text: Set reminders, mark tasks done, and see what still needs you today.

deadlines.title: Deadlines from the document
deadlines.text: Dates come from the document itself. If none is stated, LifeLens says so instead of guessing.

priority.title: Priority is your call
priority.text: AI suggests High, Medium, or Low. You can change it any time.

language.title: English and தமிழ்
language.text: Read results in English or Tamil with one tap.

camera.title: Camera ready
camera.text: Photograph a notice board or printed circular and analyze it right away.

extracted.title: Extracted vs. interpreted
extracted.text: Text taken from your document is highlighted. The AI's interpretation is labelled separately.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.text: Get a browser notification when a task is due.

home.finalText: Start with one document and see the actions in seconds.

auth.loginSub: Log in to see your tasks and deadlines.
auth.registerSub: Save your tasks, deadlines, and reminders in one place.
auth.name: Name
auth.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

analyze.title: Analyze a document
analyze.sub: Upload it, photograph it, or paste the text. LifeLens finds the actions and deadlines.
analyze.dropTitle: Choose a PDF, image, or text file
analyze.dropHint: PDF, PNG, JPG or TXT, up to 8 MB
analyze.pasteLabel: Paste or type the notice, bill, or message
analyze.pastePlaceholder: Paste the text of your document here…
analyze.workingHint: Reading the document and finding actions. This can take up to a minute.
analyze.privacy: Your original file is only used for this analysis and is not stored. Only the results are saved.
analyze.errType: That file type is not supported. Please choose a PDF, PNG, JPG or TXT file.
analyze.errSize: That file is too large. The maximum size is 8 MB.
analyze.errEmpty: That file is empty. Please choose another one.
analyze.errNoFile: Please choose a file or take a photo first.
analyze.errTextShort: Please enter a little more text to analyze.
analyze.errTextLong: That text is too long. Please keep it under 20,000 characters.

camera.hint: Point your camera at the notice or document, then take a photo.
camera.errUnsupported: Camera is not available in this browser. Use Upload file instead. (Cameras need a secure page: https or localhost.)
camera.errDenied: Camera permission was blocked. Allow camera access in your browser settings, or use Upload file instead.
camera.errNone: No camera was found on this device. Use Upload file instead.
camera.errGeneric: The camera could not be started. Please try again or use Upload file.

result.noTamil: A Tamil version is not available for this result, so it is shown in English.
result.fallbackNote: These results come from simple keyword and date matching, not from AI. They may miss details, so please check the original document.
result.extractedHint: Facts taken from the document, shown highlighted.
result.interpretationHint: The AI's reading of the document. Check it against the original.
result.confidenceNote: The AI rates its own confidence at {n}%. This is an estimate, not a guarantee.
result.addedToTasks: These actions were added to My Tasks. You can change a priority, set a reminder, or delete anything that does not apply.
result.noActionsHint: This document may be informational only. Check the summary above.

card.reminderInvalid: Please choose a valid date and time.
card.reminderSavedBrowser: Reminder saved. You will get a browser notification while LifeLens is open.
card.reminderSavedInApp: Reminder saved. You will see an alert here while LifeLens is open.
card.reminderDenied: Reminder saved, but browser notifications are off. You will see an alert inside LifeLens while it is open.
card.reminderUnsupported: Reminder saved. This browser does not support notifications, so you will see an alert inside LifeLens while it is open.
card.confirmDelete: Delete this task? This cannot be undone.

dashboard.question: What needs your attention today?
dashboard.emptyText: Analyze your first notice or document and its actions will appear here.

tasks.title: My Tasks
tasks.sub: Every action from your documents, in one list.
tasks.emptyText: Analyze a document and its actions will show up here.

deadlines.title: Deadlines
deadlines.sub: Pending tasks, ordered by how soon they are due.
deadlines.emptyText: When a document has tasks with deadlines, they will be listed here.
deadlines.noneHint: The document did not state a clear date for these tasks.

history.title: History
history.emptyText: Your analyzed documents will be listed here.
history.confirmDelete: Delete this document and all tasks created from it? This cannot be undone.

profile.title: Profile
profile.notifHint: Reminders only appear while LifeLens is open in your browser.

permission.denied: Browser notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser's site settings, or rely on in-app alerts.
permission.default: Browser notifications are not enabled yet.
permission.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications. You will see in-app alerts instead.
